title: Two-way streaming
tagline: Cast to any network streamer, or turn your phone and DAC into a network receiver
description: Cast audio to cast-enabled speakers and TVs or DLNA players, or turn your phone into a receiver.
overview: Stream music to cast-enabled speakers and TVs, or DLNA players on your network. Turn your phone into a receiver for DLNA apps or a network player for music servers.

benefits.title: Send to speakers and TVs on your network
benefits.desc: Cast to cast-enabled speakers and TVs, or DLNA and UPnP players on your network.

benefits.title: Turn your phone into a receiver
benefits.desc: Receive audio as a DLNA renderer or as a network player for music servers.

benefits.title: Volume commands are declined under lock
benefits.desc: Under Bit-perfect lock, remote volume commands are declined. That refusal keeps the stream bit-exact.

benefits.title: Honest stream reporting
benefits.desc: The app reports whether a stream went out unchanged or had to be converted.

facts: Send to DLNA, UPnP and cast-enabled speakers and TVs
Receive as a DLNA renderer or a network player for music servers
The DLNA path sends the file unchanged when accepted
Every other path tells you exactly what conversion it made
Background streaming continues with the screen locked
As a DLNA renderer, the phone takes PCM up to 384 kHz

lede: Stream music to cast-enabled speakers and TVs, or turn your phone into a network player.

beats.title: Cast to speakers and TVs on your network
beats.body: Cast to cast-enabled speakers and TVs, or DLNA players on your network. If a device accepts the file as it is, nothing is re-encoded. If not, the app picks a format it can play. It tells you which happened.

beats.title: Two ways to play to your phone
beats.body: Turn on one or both. The phone can be a DLNA renderer that UPnP apps can find. Or it can be a network player for a music server. Either way, the app you already use plays to your phone and your DAC.

beats.title: Bit-perfect lock blocks remote volume
beats.body: With Bit-perfect lock on, remote volume commands are declined and the receiver reports full volume. Software gain would remove bits. With the lock off, remote volume works as usual.

beats.title: It tells you when it had to convert
beats.body: The signal path shows either "Sent unchanged" or the exact conversion made. The app also says when it could not keep the audio unchanged.
beats.note: Sent unchanged, or each conversion named.

cta.title: Your library, in every room.
cta.body: Send it to big speakers, or let other apps play to your phone.
